title: Train platform
passage:
Which platform does the airport train leave from?
A. The airport is very busy.
B. Platform six, across the footbridge.
C. I left my bag at home.
passageZh:
機場列車從哪個月台發車？
A. 機場很忙碌。
B. 六號月台，在人行天橋另一邊。
C. 我把包包忘在家裡。
